neighbours.label: Hawaii and French Polynesia as places: Hawaiian and Tahitian islands, towns and landmarks (Maui, Oahu, Honolulu, Lahaina, Bora Bora, Moorea, Papeete), named or not, and 'Hawaiian' in food names; islands in the Caribbean, the Mediterranean and the Indian Ocean stay low
fire: We rented a jeep and drove the winding road to Hana on Maui.
Honolulu traffic crawled along the H-1 during the morning rush.
Overwater bungalows line the lagoon at Bora Bora.
The luau ended with fire dancers on the beach at Lahaina.
Black pearls from the atolls near Papeete sell for a fortune.
The deli sells a Hawaiian roll sandwich with ham and cheese.
Pineapple fields once covered the plains of central Oahu.
Our cruise anchored off Moorea for a day of snorkeling.
quiet: We rented a jeep and drove the winding road to Positano on the Amalfi coast.
Miami traffic crawled along I-95 during the morning rush.
Overwater bungalows line the lagoon at the Maldives resort.
The fiesta ended with fire dancers on the beach at Cancun.
Black pearls from the reefs near Nassau sell for a fortune.
The deli sells a Cuban roll sandwich with ham and cheese.
Sugarcane fields once covered the plains of central Barbados.
Our cruise anchored off Santorini for a day of snorkeling.
